people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Yahweh said to me, “A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: And the LORD told me, “There is a conspiracy among the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
